<h2>Check for Shared sjSDM Tuning Evidence</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reads every requested native-v2 unit tuning artifact and reports whether at
least one contains candidate evidence. Missing, unreadable, or malformed
inputs fail closed.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>has_sjsdm_tuning_evidence(
  store_paths = NULL,
  target_names = NULL,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="store_paths">store_paths</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of unit targets-store paths.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_names">target_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of tuning-summary target names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable target reader. Defaults to [targets::tar_read_raw()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>One logical value.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
has_sjsdm_tuning_evidence(
  store_paths = "Data/targets/unit/pipeline",
  target_names = "list_sjsdm_cv_tuning_artifact"
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
